notes: Fresh checks for the USGS Afghanistan pre-mining baselines loaded 14 Nov 2026 (AFGHANISTAN_USGS_BASELINE). Not part of the gate.

questions.q: What copper values do the USGS samples around the Aynak deposit in Afghanistan show, by sample type?
questions.judge: Uses AFGHANISTAN_USGS_BASELINE samples whose comments mention Aynak and reports Cu by sample type (rock, sediment, soil, mine waste) with ppm units, e.g. counts, medians and maxima. Says these are USGS pre-mining environmental baseline samples from 2019-2020 around the deposit (not regional coverage). Credits the USGS. Does not mix in other deposits.

questions.q: What geochemistry do you have for Afghanistan?
questions.judge: Says the data are about 303 USGS baseline samples (rock, sediment, soil, mine waste) around four deposits only - Aynak and Balkhab copper, Hajigak and Nuqra Khana iron - from 2019-2020, analysed for about 60 elements, and that there is no country-wide survey in the database. Credits the USGS. Does not claim regional coverage.
